answer: Each PoA challenge is instantiated after its designated drand quicknet round, deriving task parameters and a nonce from the verified threshold-BLS pulse and chain context. Because the pulse is unpredictable before publication, agents cannot precompute valid responses or farm them offline across fabricated identities. Commitments bind responses to that challenge, and verification checks the beacon proof. An echo, plume, or dune of sybils gains no advantage without performing the assigned work.
